source_commit_note: The integrated driver was built and executed against the clean Toolbox commit 01a9c68 at 2026-09-07 21:34 +0800. Toolbox HEAD moved to 32dcee8 after that run; the new commit separates lobby creation pause from strict online capability and was not used to rebuild this driver.

steps.observed_result: Release driver compiled successfully; only an unused synthetic refresh constant warning was emitted.

The driver reported resync=true and logic_bridge=PASS. result.environment: Windows loopback only; the harness used synthetic local HTTP auth, Meta HTTP, WebSocket, and TCP logic services, the real Toolbox HTTP/config/RealtimeFeed/MetaTunnel client, and an isolated LOCALAPPDATA profile.
result.observed_result: The integrated HTTP/WS/MetaTunnel/logout/switch scenario passed. The configuration-write interruption recovery passed separately. Overall E2E-11 remains PARTIAL because the DPAPI interruption is not injected into the same integrated run and no production backend, Steam/native game, signed payload, or multi-machine transport was exercised.

limitations: The integrated driver used synthetic loopback services and does not prove the production HTTP/WS/MetaTunnel service, Steam session, native game, signed payload, PostgreSQL, or multi-machine path.
Configuration write interruption was a real targeted child-writer test, but it was not interleaved with the integrated token rotation scenario; this prevents an overall PASS claim.
The driver artifact is tied to source commit 01a9c68. Current HEAD 32dcee8 was committed after the driver build and requires separate revalidation for its lobby capability-gate changes.
No access token, refresh token, Steam ticket, or other secret was written to the logs or this result.
